facts.raw_span: female neonate born at 37+6 weeks gestation
birth weight of 2790g
Apgar score 5-8-9
Inaudible cry and laryngeal stridor
Difficulty swallowing with choking and excessive oral secretions
Hypotonia and flaccid limbs
Mother's history: strabismus, cataract, and cardiac anomalies including PDA
PDA, patent foramen ovale, widened coronary sinus, permanent left superior vena cava and pericardial effusion
Heterozygous variant in ATAD3A gene (c.1517A>C; p.Q506P)
CSF: Mildly elevated WBC count initially, normalized on repeat testing
Chest CT: Shows pneumonia
Follow-up EEG: Increased amplitude of all-conductor waves with scattered spikes
